description: Branch R-FMT-2 Calculated wrappers, numeric magnitude (public side), on an ACCDB. One table per result type, made through CreateTableDef with Expression before append: Long [A] * 1000 and [A] * [A] (overflow of the declared type), Double [A] ^ 5, Currency [A] * 100000, Decimal [A] * 100000000000000 and [A] * -100000000000000 (up to 24 digits). Rows A = 1, 2147483647, -2147483647, 0 and Null are written through a recordset and read back (each insert with dbFailOnError and a marked Errors read). C's Type, Size and ResultType are read. Asks what the engine stores or refuses when a calculated result exceeds its declared type and how the 12- and 16-byte magnitudes read back.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
